versions.content: Resolve BlueprintVariationPoints on time When elements are copied from a variation point to a system configuration, then only those variation points may be transferred that are allowed to be variation points at systemDesignTime or later. Hence, any variation of an ARElement (or something derived from it) in a blueprint that would be prohibited by [constr_2537] (which limits variation points to certain elements) has an implicit latest binding time of bluePrintDerivationTime .
